issues.detail: The Hebrew lists only three entities: the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim (Hena and Ivvah are named as the gods of Sepharvaim, not as separate kings/cities). The Vietnamese adds 'Hê-ma và A-na' as additional kings/cities, which is not in the Hebrew. The Hebrew 'הֵנַע וְעִוָּה' (Hena and Ivvah) are the gods of Sepharvaim, not separate kings or cities to be asked about.
